title: Core Nonet #02
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, nine women in a single row.

A photograph of NINE women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 9 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Bollywood Glam / Amazoness]: Indian woman, mid 40s, demure and soft, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in braided, stiletto nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera. Shoes: extreme cream platform stiletto cross-strap sandals.

[Uzbek Silk Road Glam / Glamour Hourglass]: Uzbek woman, late 50s, bold and confident, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in elegant updo, oval nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward. Shoes: extreme gold-and-crimson platform stiletto studded boots.

[yamanba / Nubian Bootybuilder]: Japanese woman, mid 20s, demure and soft, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a bold cheeky grin, soft pastel-peach hair styled in low bun, almond nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back. Shoes: extreme ochre platform stiletto slingbacks.

[Turkish Glam / Curved Bust]: Turkish woman, early 40s, demure and soft, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, coffin nails (matte). Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. [Bollywood Glam / Legend Bust]: Indian woman, mid 30s, cool and composed, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, almond nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 9, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
